recommendations.recommendation: Unite knowing and acting; true knowledge is already action.
recommendations.rationale: Knowing and doing are one process; separation is a flaw.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Extend the innate knowing of the good (liangzhi) in every situation.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Look for principle in the mind rather than in external things.
Eliminate selfish desires and preserve heavenly principle.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Set your resolve firmly to become a sage.
recommendations.rationale: Sagehood depends on will, and anyone can attain it.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Practice cultivation in daily affairs and be vigilant even when alone.
recommendations.rationale: Practice must be tested in actual affairs.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Care for all things as one body.
recommendations.rationale: The mind forms one body with Heaven, Earth, and all things.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
